# Vendored: Tabulator

`tabulator.min.js` and `tabulator.min.css` are Tabulator 6.3.1 (MIT, see `LICENSE`), copied unchanged from `dist/` of the `tabulator-tables@6.3.1` tarball on the npm registry (https://registry.npmjs.org/tabulator-tables/-/tabulator-tables-6.3.1.tgz), except that the trailing `sourceMappingURL` comment was removed so that browser dev tools do not request a map file we do not ship. The site loads them by relative path and never talks to a CDN. To upgrade, download the new tarball, replace the two files, and look at every view once.
